But we should check if there's any more recent change. It's currently 2026-10-19. In real world, as of 2026, the governor might still be Gavin Newsom or someone else. Let's assume it's still Gavin Newsom unless there's an election. California gubernatorial elections happen every four years; the last one was in 2022, so next would be 2026. If the user is asking now in October 2026, maybe the election has happened. Actually, California had a gubernatorial election in November 2026. So the result might have been decided. But I don't know the outcome. However, the user didn't specify a date. They just asked "Who is the Governor of California?" Usually we answer with the current governor. Since it's 2026-10-19, before the election, the incumbent is still Gavin Newsom. So answer: Gavin Newsom.
